rater: Kyle Yeh, former high-school Spanish teacher
method: Read the six compositions blind, with no access to the intended targets and before seeing any output from the app.
note: Levels were given as ranges, which is how a teacher actually reads a single short sample. Both the range and its midpoint are used; a placement inside the range counts as agreement.

A.comment: Zero errors, which is itself a problem with the item -- see item_critiques.

C.comment: Rater noted never having graded a student this high, so treat as a less certain judgement.

item_critiques.A: The rater observed that Muestra A contains no errors at all. ACTFL's Intermediate Mid descriptor expects control of basic structures but not error-free writing, so an error-free text is not a well-formed Intermediate Mid item. The target may be mis-written rather than the rating being wrong, and the item is flagged rather than silently counted.
